overview: 今日专题“科技、能源与产业”。共筛选 23 个高价值事件，重点关注中国相关进展、美国相关进展及全球外交、经济与安全动态。

featured.title: Chinese markets lose trillions as race for AI supremacy with US takes its toll
featured.summary: Lack of profits and the threat posed by western countries are raising concern about the sustainability of Beijing’s AI boom Trillions of dollars have been wiped from China’s stock markets in recent months amid increasing anxiety about the future of artificial intelligence, as Beijing races against the United States for dominance in the sector. The STAR 50 Index, which tracks technology and innovation companies on the Shanghai stock exchange, has plunged 40% since June. Other indexes of major companies dropped by about 20% over the same time period. Continue reading...
featured.titleZh: 中国股市蒸发数万亿，中美人工智能竞争代价显现
featured.summaryZh: 由于缺乏盈利能力及西方国家的制裁威胁，中国人工智能行业的繁荣引发担忧。近期中国股市科技板块大幅下跌，反映出市场对行业前景的焦虑。
featured.whyImportant: 这显示了在激烈的全球技术竞争背景下，资本市场对中国AI产业可持续性的信心波动。

featured.summary: Chinese space scientists are working out how future astronauts on Mars could make their own fuel out of thin air, a sign that Beijing is serious about one day sending people to the red planet. featured.titleZh: 中国科学家研发出强力催化剂，可将火星大气转化为火箭燃料
featured.summaryZh: 中国科研团队开发出一种催化剂，能将火星大气中丰富的二氧化碳转化为甲醇燃料。这一技术突破为未来火星探测任务提供了能源自给的可能性。

featured.summary: Hong Kong authorities have proposed raising the residential share of a Hung Hom harbourfront development to more than 60 per cent by cutting commercial floor space, citing “strong doubts” over market demand for offices. featured.titleZh: 香港提议增加红磡海滨住宅用地，减少办公空间
featured.summaryZh: 香港发展局提议将红磡海滨开发的住宅比例提高至60%以上，并削减商业楼面面积。此举旨在应对市场对办公空间需求疲软的现状，并优化土地用途。
featured.whyImportant: 该规划调整反映了香港政府根据市场需求变化，对城市土地利用策略进行的灵活调整。

global.titleZh: 澳大利亚政治直播：联盟党要求阿尔巴尼斯停止在600万澳元高尔夫拨款问题上的“粉饰”；工党承诺对议员安全问题做出“迅速回应”
global.summaryZh: 在独立议员海恩斯遇袭受伤后，澳大利亚政界就政治辩论的文明性展开讨论。自由党参议员安妮·鲁斯顿呼吁保持尊重，并指出社交媒体平台在加剧政治言论失控方面负有责任。
global.whyImportant: 此事件凸显了澳大利亚政界对政治暴力和网络言论环境恶化的担忧，引发了关于如何规范社交媒体及维护议员安全的广泛讨论。

global.title: Jordan carries out deadly strike in Syria in retaliation for church attack
global.summary: The attack on a village in Syria killed five people, including women and children, Syrian health officials said.
global.titleZh: 约旦对叙利亚发动致命空袭，以报复教堂袭击事件
global.summaryZh: 叙利亚卫生官员表示，约旦对叙利亚境内一个村庄发动的空袭造成包括妇女和儿童在内的五人死亡。此次行动被视为对近期教堂袭击事件的报复。
global.whyImportant: 此次跨境军事行动加剧了约旦与叙利亚之间的紧张局势，对地区安全稳定构成潜在威胁。

global.title: Hong Kong wants to be a regional hub for Halloween. Why not?
global.summary: Hong Kong’s determination to become a hub for everything – innovation, finance, trade, culture and sport – appears to know no bounds. Now, Halloween has been added to the list. The city is aiming to become Asia’s premier destination for the annual spookfest. Of all the regional hubs Hong Kong wishes to become, this is one of the more unlikely. But with Beijing urging the city to ensure “tourism is everywhere” and draw ever more visitors, Halloween, falling between the National Day “golden week”...
global.titleZh: 香港希望成为万圣节区域中心，为何不可？
global.summaryZh: 香港正致力于将自身打造为亚洲首屈一指的万圣节庆祝目的地，以响应北京关于促进旅游业多元化发展的号召。尽管这一目标看似不同寻常，但香港正试图通过各类活动吸引更多游客。
global.whyImportant: 此举反映了香港在经济转型期积极拓展旅游资源，试图通过打造特色节庆活动来提升城市吸引力和国际竞争力。

global.title: Harry Kane wins Ballon d’Or, ending England’s 25-year wait
global.summary: Bayern Munich and England striker Harry Kane has won his first Ballon d’Or after a record-breaking season.
global.titleZh: 哈里·凯恩荣膺金球奖，终结英格兰25年等待
global.summaryZh: 拜仁慕尼黑队及英格兰国家队前锋哈里·凯恩凭借破纪录的赛季表现，首次赢得了金球奖。这是英格兰球员时隔25年后再次获此殊荣。
global.whyImportant: 这一成就不仅是对凯恩个人职业生涯的最高认可，也标志着英格兰足球在国际足坛影响力的重要时刻。

global.title: Taiwan looks to autonomous swarms to counter Beijing’s grey-zone pressure
global.summary: Taiwan is developing an AI-powered system to coordinate drone fleets for maritime surveillance and countering “grey-zone” activities, with researchers completing a simulation involving 20 aircraft, according to the island’s Ocean Affairs Council. The system, which is funded by the council, would allow different types of drones to autonomously divide tasks, plan routes and coordinate their movements while providing wide-area, persistent surveillance for coastguard operations. The council said on...
global.titleZh: 台湾寻求利用无人机群应对北京的“灰色地带”压力
global.summaryZh: 台湾海洋事务委员会正在开发一套人工智能系统，用于协调无人机群进行海上监视和应对“灰色地带”活动。研究人员已完成包含20架无人机的模拟测试，旨在实现任务自动分配与协同巡航。
global.whyImportant: 该技术的发展显示出台湾正试图通过提升无人化作战能力，以应对日益复杂的区域安全挑战。

global.title: Can Hong Kong deliver in trying to build its yuan credentials?

In the first of a four-part series on the internationalisation of the yuan, Lam Ka-sing and Denise Tsang examine Hong Kong’s efforts as an international financial centre to reform its market infrastructure, including building a larger offshore renminbi...
global.titleZh: 香港能否在建立人民币信誉方面取得成功？
global.summaryZh: 香港特首李家超在政策地址中强调，推动人民币在境外更广泛使用是香港的战略重点。香港正通过改革市场基础设施和扩大离岸人民币业务，巩固其作为国际金融中心的地位。
global.whyImportant: 香港在人民币国际化进程中的角色至关重要，其相关政策的成效将直接影响人民币在全球金融体系中的地位。

global.summary: China has released footage of its troops carrying out a “no-notice” rocket launch as part of an ongoing effort by state media to showcase the People’s Liberation Army’s rapid-response capabilities. global.titleZh: 中国发布“无预警”东风导弹演习画面传递了什么信息？
global.summaryZh: 中国央视发布了军队在山区进行“无预警”火箭发射演习的视频，旨在展示解放军的快速反应能力。此次演习未提前通知参演部队，强调了实战化训练要求。
global.whyImportant: 通过展示高机动性和快速响应能力，中国旨在向外界传递其军事现代化进程及应对突发状况的战略威慑力。

global.title: Jordan strikes Syria after church attack, killing at least seven people
global.summary: Syria closes border crossings with Jordan after air strikes kill seven people in Deraa and Suweyda, including children.
global.titleZh: 约旦空袭叙利亚造成至少七人死亡，以报复教堂袭击
global.summaryZh: 约旦对叙利亚德拉和苏韦达地区发动空袭，造成包括儿童在内的七人死亡。随后，叙利亚宣布关闭与约旦的边境口岸。
global.whyImportant: 此次流血冲突导致两国边境局势骤然紧张，进一步恶化了本已脆弱的地区外交关系。

global.title: Jordan attacks Syria in response to Karak church attack
global.summary: Jordan’s air force has carried out several strikes in southern Syria in response to Friday’s church attack.

global.summaryZh: 为回应周五发生的教堂袭击事件，约旦空军对叙利亚南部进行了多次空袭。此次行动旨在打击相关武装势力。
global.whyImportant: 此举标志着约旦在应对国内恐怖袭击时采取了跨境军事报复行动，可能加剧地区紧张局势。

global.summaryZh: 由于欺诈和洗钱案件数量激增，香港法院面临严重的积压问题。司法机构建议延长开庭时间至晚间以缓解诉讼压力。
global.whyImportant: 案件积压反映了香港法律体系在应对复杂金融犯罪时面临的资源挑战。

china.title: HSBC reports 32% increase in third quarter pre-tax profits, announces US$1b share buy-back
china.summary: HSBC, Hong Kong’s biggest lender, reported a 32 per cent rise in third quarter pre-tax profits while announcing a US$1 billion share buy-back on Tuesday. The bank said its third quarter pre-tax profit increased to US$9.6 billion, in-line with US$9.7 billion estimated by analysts, compared with US$7.3 billion a year earlier. The buy-back amount for the third quarter was in line with analysts’ estimates. More to follow …
china.titleZh: 汇丰银行第三季度税前利润增长32%，宣布10亿美元股票回购计划

usa.title: FTC and 20 states sue Dollar General, accusing bargain chain of overcharging customers

And it is doubtful we will ever have such a friendly president again,” Netanyahu said in a televised appearance...
usa.titleZh: 以色列大选：内塔尼亚胡宣扬特朗普支持，暗示可能重启对伊战争
usa.summaryZh: 以色列总理内塔尼亚胡在大选前夕强调了特朗普的支持，并暗示若其胜选，两人可能重启针对伊朗的战争。内塔尼亚胡称特朗普是美以关系史上最友好的总统。

usa.title: Trump suggests renaming the Atlantic Ocean the ‘American Ocean’

watch.titleZh: 香港提议增加红磡海滨住宅用地，减少办公空间

watch.whyImportant: 该规划调整反映了香港政府根据市场需求变化，对城市土地利用策略进行的灵活调整。

items.title: Chinese markets lose trillions as race for AI supremacy with US takes its toll
items.summary: Lack of profits and the threat posed by western countries are raising concern about the sustainability of Beijing’s AI boom Trillions of dollars have been wiped from China’s stock markets in recent months amid increasing anxiety about the future of artificial intelligence, as Beijing races against the United States for dominance in the sector. The STAR 50 Index, which tracks technology and innovation companies on the Shanghai stock exchange, has plunged 40% since June. Other indexes of major companies dropped by about 20% over the same time period. Continue reading...
items.titleZh: 中国股市蒸发数万亿，中美人工智能竞争代价显现
items.summaryZh: 由于缺乏盈利能力及西方国家的制裁威胁，中国人工智能行业的繁荣引发担忧。近期中国股市科技板块大幅下跌，反映出市场对行业前景的焦虑。

items.summary: Chinese space scientists are working out how future astronauts on Mars could make their own fuel out of thin air, a sign that Beijing is serious about one day sending people to the red planet. items.titleZh: 中国科学家研发出强力催化剂，可将火星大气转化为火箭燃料
items.summaryZh: 中国科研团队开发出一种催化剂，能将火星大气中丰富的二氧化碳转化为甲醇燃料。这一技术突破为未来火星探测任务提供了能源自给的可能性。
items.whyImportant: 该技术对于实现人类长期火星探索任务的能源补给具有重要的战略意义。

items.titleZh: 澳大利亚政治直播：联盟党要求阿尔巴尼斯停止在600万澳元高尔夫拨款问题上的“粉饰”；工党承诺对议员安全问题做出“迅速回应”
items.summaryZh: 在独立议员海恩斯遇袭受伤后，澳大利亚政界就政治辩论的文明性展开讨论。自由党参议员安妮·鲁斯顿呼吁保持尊重，并指出社交媒体平台在加剧政治言论失控方面负有责任。
items.whyImportant: 此事件凸显了澳大利亚政界对政治暴力和网络言论环境恶化的担忧，引发了关于如何规范社交媒体及维护议员安全的广泛讨论。

items.title: Jordan carries out deadly strike in Syria in retaliation for church attack
items.summary: The attack on a village in Syria killed five people, including women and children, Syrian health officials said.
items.titleZh: 约旦对叙利亚发动致命空袭，以报复教堂袭击事件
items.summaryZh: 叙利亚卫生官员表示，约旦对叙利亚境内一个村庄发动的空袭造成包括妇女和儿童在内的五人死亡。此次行动被视为对近期教堂袭击事件的报复。
items.whyImportant: 此次跨境军事行动加剧了约旦与叙利亚之间的紧张局势，对地区安全稳定构成潜在威胁。

items.title: Hong Kong wants to be a regional hub for Halloween. Why not?
items.summary: Hong Kong’s determination to become a hub for everything – innovation, finance, trade, culture and sport – appears to know no bounds. Now, Halloween has been added to the list. items.titleZh: 香港希望成为万圣节区域中心，为何不可？
items.summaryZh: 香港正致力于将自身打造为亚洲首屈一指的万圣节庆祝目的地，以响应北京关于促进旅游业多元化发展的号召。尽管这一目标看似不同寻常，但香港正试图通过各类活动吸引更多游客。
items.whyImportant: 此举反映了香港在经济转型期积极拓展旅游资源，试图通过打造特色节庆活动来提升城市吸引力和国际竞争力。

items.title: Harry Kane wins Ballon d’Or, ending England’s 25-year wait
items.summary: Bayern Munich and England striker Harry Kane has won his first Ballon d’Or after a record-breaking season.
items.titleZh: 哈里·凯恩荣膺金球奖，终结英格兰25年等待

items.title: Taiwan looks to autonomous swarms to counter Beijing’s grey-zone pressure
items.summary: Taiwan is developing an AI-powered system to coordinate drone fleets for maritime surveillance and countering “grey-zone” activities, with researchers completing a simulation involving 20 aircraft, according to the island’s Ocean Affairs Council. The system, which is funded by the council, would allow different types of drones to autonomously divide tasks, plan routes and coordinate their movements while providing wide-area, persistent surveillance for coastguard operations. items.titleZh: 台湾寻求利用无人机群应对北京的“灰色地带”压力
items.summaryZh: 台湾海洋事务委员会正在开发一套人工智能系统，用于协调无人机群进行海上监视和应对“灰色地带”活动。研究人员已完成包含20架无人机的模拟测试，旨在实现任务自动分配与协同巡航。

items.title: Can Hong Kong deliver in trying to build its yuan credentials?
items.summary: In September, Chief Executive John Lee Ka-chiu unveiled the city’s first five-year plan along with his policy address, highlighting Hong Kong’s strategic role in promoting the greater use of the yuan outside mainland China as a key priority. items.titleZh: 香港能否在建立人民币信誉方面取得成功？
items.summaryZh: 香港特首李家超在政策地址中强调，推动人民币在境外更广泛使用是香港的战略重点。香港正通过改革市场基础设施和扩大离岸人民币业务，巩固其作为国际金融中心的地位。
items.whyImportant: 香港在人民币国际化进程中的角色至关重要，其相关政策的成效将直接影响人民币在全球金融体系中的地位。

items.title: What message is China sending with latest footage of ‘no-notice’ DF rocket drill?
items.summary: China has released footage of its troops carrying out a “no-notice” rocket launch as part of an ongoing effort by state media to showcase the People’s Liberation Army’s rapid-response capabilities. State broadcaster CCTV on Monday released a brief video showing the exercise in mountainous terrain and said it had been carried out with no advance notice given to the troops involved. No other details were provided. The footage – which is believed to show a missile from the Dongfeng (east wind)...
items.titleZh: 中国发布“无预警”东风导弹演习画面传递了什么信息？
items.summaryZh: 中国央视发布了军队在山区进行“无预警”火箭发射演习的视频，旨在展示解放军的快速反应能力。此次演习未提前通知参演部队，强调了实战化训练要求。

items.title: HSBC reports 32% increase in third quarter pre-tax profits, announces US$1b share buy-back

items.titleZh: 汇丰银行第三季度税前利润增长32%，宣布10亿美元股票回购计划

items.title: Trump suggests renaming the Atlantic Ocean the ‘American Ocean’

items.titleZh: 特朗普建议将大西洋更名为“美国大洋”
items.summaryZh: 美国总统特朗普在共和党集会上提议将大西洋重新命名为“美国大洋”。

items.title: In Egypt, Guterres warns against Iran-US escalation

items.title: Trump administration asks Washington to set aside hundreds of ballots from suspected noncitizen voters

items.titleZh: 特朗普政府要求华盛顿州搁置数百张涉嫌非公民选民的选票

items.summary: Almost 2,000 customers of Hong Kong Airlines and two electronic appliance retailers received fraudulent calls after their personal information was leaked by the companies, the city’s privacy watchdog has found. items.titleZh: 香港航空及两家电器店发生数据泄露，近2000名客户遭诈骗电话骚扰
items.summaryZh: 香港个人资料私隐专员公署发现，香港航空及两家电器零售商发生数据泄露，导致近2000名客户接到诈骗电话。目前公署已收到数十起相关投诉并展开调查。
items.whyImportant: 此事件凸显了企业在保护客户个人隐私方面存在的安全漏洞，以及数据泄露对公众造成的直接经济风险。
